title: Preserve exact-query run status when a matching index entry is refreshed mid-query
outcome: When the registration and captured disk identity still match but a normal rescan replaces the index Arc during off-lock canonicalization, exact GET avoids falsely showing a known Running run as Unknown/interrupted solely because the Arc changed. Use a safely revalidated current index entry or an explicit retry response while preserving the durable content fence and avoiding filesystem IO under StateInner.
acceptance: A deterministic refresh-during-query control covers a matching durable/index identity and distinguishes ordinary refresh from real identity replacement.
The chosen response preserves the durable locator/identity and accurately states whether current artifact status is known; real identity replacement remains fail-closed.
